findings.title: Star schema / shared output table design
findings.evidence: The repository defines a reusable star-schema target with documented grain and keys: README.md describes the Reporting data warehouse and star-schema structure; MarketRate_SQL/CreateEthanolMarketRateFact.sql documents the grain as one row per product per market date and uses a surrogate key plus unique grain constraint; MarketRate_SQL/CreateProductDim.sql documents ProductDim as a dimension table. The load script MarketRate_Pipeline/03_LoadToWarehouse.py also validates grain before loading.

findings.title: Data quality validation present
findings.evidence: Data quality validation is present in multiple pipeline stages: MarketRate_Pipeline/01_IngestData.py uses pandera schema validation plus explicit null, duplicate, and range checks before writing to silver; MarketRate_Pipeline/02_TransformData.py checks for unknown regions and grain duplicates before writing to gold; MarketRate_Pipeline/03_LoadToWarehouse.py performs null and duplicate checks before loading to the warehouse.

findings.title: Git branching and commit standards
findings.evidence: azure-pipelines.yml references only master and develop in both trigger and pr sections, and the PR config requires at least one approver (minimumApprovers: 1). README.md documents the branch strategy including master, develop, and user-story/{id}, which matches the allowed model.

findings.title: Logging and monitoring
findings.evidence: The pipeline scripts use the logging module with run-start/run-end messages and exception logging: MarketRate_Pipeline/01_IngestData.py, 02_TransformData.py, and 03_LoadToWarehouse.py each configure logging, log job start/completion, and use logger.exception/logger.error in error paths rather than relying only on print().

findings.title: No hardcoded secrets or credentials
findings.evidence: No hardcoded secrets or credentials are present in code. MarketRate_Pipeline/03_LoadToWarehouse.py builds the connection string exclusively from environment variables (DB_SERVER, DB_NAME, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD), and README.md instructs users to supply credentials via environment variables / Azure Key Vault rather than embedding literal secrets.

findings.title: Reproducibility
findings.evidence: Reproducibility controls are present: requirements.txt pins package versions, and MarketRate_Pipeline/02_TransformData.py explicitly sets np.random.seed(42). The pipeline also reads raw bronze files and writes validated/transformed copies to silver and gold rather than overwriting the raw source files in place.
